title: Rutinas diarias

lesson.title: El presente simple: rutinas y la -s de he/she/it
lesson.rule: El presente simple describe rutinas: I wake up at 7:00. Con he/she/it el verbo lleva -s: She wakes up. Las horas se dicen con 'at': at 7:00, at noon, at night. Los adverbios de frecuencia (usually, always, sometimes) van antes del verbo: I usually have breakfast.
examples: I usually have breakfast at home.
commonMistakes: She wake up → She wakes up
I usually breakfast have → I usually have breakfast

pronunciationTip: La -s de la 3ª persona suena distinto: works /s/, plays /z/, watches /ɪz/. Practica: she works, she plays, she watches.

phrases.en: I usually have breakfast at home.
I work from Monday to Friday.

exercises.prompt: Traduce al inglés: “Voy al trabajo a las 8:00.”
Ordena la frase: “Usualmente desayuno en casa.”

speak: Describe tu rutina desde que te despiertas hasta que te acuestas. 60 segundos.
challenge: Explica tu rutina ideal de la mañana en 5 oraciones.
